note: Single source of truth for owner crypto receive addresses that are fanned out into repo secrets. Public receive addresses only — never place a private key or seed here. Consumed by scripts/rotate-crypto-addresses.mjs (secret fan-out), by scripts/lib/owner-routes.mjs (payout destination resolution) and by the allowlist inventory scan inside .github/workflows/owner-crypto-withdraw.yml.

depositRoutes.note: Custodial exchange deposit routes (customer incoming payments). These are NOT owner wallets and NOT withdrawal destinations: allowlisting one would send a withdrawal into an exchange deposit address. Verified live against the provider API on verifiedAt — re-verify before ever treating one as stale.

routes.note: Pre-set owner destinations, one entry per (rail, asset, network). This is what the payout rails resolve against: a rail MUST refuse to send when the requested route is absent, ambiguous, unverified, or carries no address. Never invent an address to make a route usable — leave verified=false with address=null until the owner supplies a real address they control on that chain. A route is not a deposit route: an exchange deposit address here would bounce funds back to the exchange.

list.note: Higher network fee; fallback when BEP20 is unavailable.

list.verifiedVia: EIP-55 checksum + owner declaration (same owner EVM wallet as bitget)
list.note: Same owner wallet as the bitget BEP20 route; declared per-rail so the binance rail resolves it without any caller-supplied address.
